reject_effect: Keep FU-CR161-001 as a candidate; future runs continue to report ExperimentFamilyManifest=typed_unavailable and C1 remains input-blocked.
scope_summary: 把当前“研究完成后由调用方手工填写 `trial_count`”升级为“研究开始前声明试验族、运行中自动记录每个 trial/attempt/selection、结束时封存并校验完整谱系”的可审计机制。目标是让未来研究运行能够合法产生 `ExperimentFamilyManifest.availability=present`，为 CR151/CR154/admission package 提供可信 lineage ref；本 CR 解决 C1 的事实来源，不计算多重检验或过拟合校正。
split_rationale: CR161 deliberately stopped at design-only typed_unavailable semantics; this follow-up has a distinct implementation, verification, rollback, and audit boundary.
title: Trial Lineage Instrumentation
user_goal_impact: Future candidate-producing research runs can legitimately emit ExperimentFamilyManifest=present without treating lineage instrumentation as statistical correction.
why_not_merge_with_parent: CR161 and CR162 are closed historical baselines. Reopening them would mix design-only closure evidence with a new implementation lifecycle.
why_not_story_or_task: The change crosses public contracts, research entrypoints, admission consumers, persistence semantics, five Stories, and independent verification; it requires its own CP2/CP3/CP5/CP8 decisions.
